# Capacitiq Solutions

Capacitiq Solutions (Pty) Ltd, trading as Capacitiq, is a South African business support agency. We help startups and SMEs build the systems, strategy, and execution support they need to grow with intention. B-BBEE Level 1 Contributor. Registration No. 2026/344156/07. Operating remotely across South Africa from Johannesburg.
